Face: declaration. The face is owed only because of the `Clause-②: yes` line in the PR body and the changeset. The committed tree has no published schema (`packages/spec/src/**` is untouched) and no governed path: `check-governed-merges --pr 26659` reports 0 of 15 paths, ≤ 3000 lines. There is no narrowing line.

### ① Derived judgments

- **`@object-ui/i18n` public surface widens by two members.** All ten packs (`ar de en es fr ja ko pt ru zh`) gain `oauth.consent.scope.metadataWrite` and `oauth.consent.scope.unrecognised`, so `TranslationKeys` (`typeof en`) gains two members. Nothing is removed or renamed. A host reading an existing key is unaffected. A host that types its own full pack against `TranslationKeys` must add the two rows. That is the same reach as every earlier widening in this package's CHANGELOG. **Correct.**
- **`unrecognised` takes a `{{scope}}` placeholder in every pack.** The diff carries the placeholder in all ten rows, and the call site passes `scope`. **Correct.**
- **`@object-ui/console` consent screen.** The screen now imports `MCP_OAUTH_SCOPES`, `MCP_OAUTH_SCOPE_CONSENT_COPY`, the four scope constants and `McpOauthScope` from `@objectstack/spec/ai`. All of them are exported on main (`packages/spec/src/ai/mcp.zod.ts`, re-exported by `ai/index.ts`), and console already depends on `@objectstack/spec` (`workspace:^`).
  - `describeAgentScope` switches over `McpOauthScope` with no default, so a fifth spec scope with no case fails to compile. That is the drift guard the card asked for.
  - The default text is the spec's copy, so the server-side sentence and the screen's fallback cannot diverge.
  - A scope outside the known set renders as "Unrecognised permission: …" instead of the bare string.
  - No exported runtime contract changes: `OAuthConsentPage` keeps its signature, and the helpers are module-private.
  - **Correct.**
- **QA checklist (`docs/qa/platform-checklist/areas/ai.json` rev 6).** "All four scopes" and the four-scope `WWW-Authenticate` list match `packages/runtime/src/domains/mcp.ts`, which joins `MCP_OAUTH_SCOPES` into the 403 body and header. The `metadata:write` variants row cites `registerAuthoringTools` in `packages/mcp/src/mcp-server-runtime.ts`, which exists. This is a prose face, not part of the contract. **Correct.**

### ② Semver level

The changeset declares `patch` for `@object-ui/i18n` and `@object-ui/console`. That matches this package's precedent: a widening-only key addition ships as patch, and only a removal (narrowing) is `minor` under objectui's version policy, as the CHANGELOG records for `timeline.bucket.overdue`. **Consistent.**

### ③ Boundary flags

The dev raised four deviations. Each is answered below.

- Two pack keys instead of the one the claim named: accepted. The `unrecognised` key is what keeps an unknown scope from rendering bare, and it falls inside the claimed `locales/*.ts` surface.
- `ai.json` `steps[5]` and the variants row were also fixed: accepted. They follow the same fourth scope in the same claimed file.
- `check-closing-target-claim` UNDETERMINED because of the claim's Branch-line parenthetical: a reader artefact, not a defect. The claim (6440101598) names `claude/project-thread-9l8r78`, which is this PR's head ref, and the body's first line is `Fixes #26587`.
- The eager-bundle cost of the `@objectstack/spec/ai` import was not measured: not blocking. This is the first `/ai` subpath import in console source. Console already imports the package root and six other subpaths (`api`, `contracts`, `data`, `shared`, `system`, `ui`). The new import brings in constants and a type. `Build & E2E UI` at this head decides whether the build holds. The seat measured no bundle size.
- PR `user.login` is `objectstack-fleet[bot]`, so there is no outside author to name.

**VERDICT: PASS**
